text:
maya: eval-bot just surfaced a heatmap/delta anomaly from tonight's nightly eval :rotating_light: — rdx-v2q shows a drop on two cohorts (investor-qa, longform-summarize). severity=medium. tagging @diego @li for bring-up owners

eval-bot: ALERT nightly_eval 1959001234 model=rdx-v2q cohorts=[investor-qa,longform-summarize] metric=coherence delta=-3.8% p=0.006 heatmap_bucket=length>512 samples=12

diego: On it, grabbing failing samples now. Posting quick snippet in a sec.

li: Is this the int4 quant path? Which quant profile was used for these runs (symmetric/asymmetric)?

maya: Nightly matrix: baseline=rdx-v2 (fp16), candidate=rdx-v2q (int4, asymmetric-default). Notable: cohort longform-summarize had average coherence drop from 0.82 -> 0.79 for lengths >512. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/evals/1959001234 (internal)

sam: I remember a similar small drop last week on a different promptset. Might be KV-cache misalignment after quantization. @kerry any runtime flags changed overnight?

kerry: No runtime deploys on my side. I can run the replay locally. Can someone paste seeds and exact run args?

diego: Sample failures (truncated) — prompt and candidate generation below:

```
Prompt: "Summarize the following earnings call focusing on guidance and risk factors... [long transcript truncated]"
Candidate (rdx-v2q): "The company expects revenue to grow moderately but did not mention any specific guidance due to market uncertainty. They also did not disclose risks."
Expected (rdx-v2): "Management reiterated guidance of 8-10% revenue growth; highlighted FX headwinds and a potential supply-chain risk in APAC."
Issue: hallucinated omission + collapsed factual detail.
```

li: That candidate looks like it truncated or blurred pieces of the context. Quick check: tokenize lengths for the failing inputs are ~20 tokens higher under the candidate tokenization (weird). Could be tokenizer/merge table mismatch after model conversion.

maya: For triage: Owner assignments -> diego (sample repro + dataset slice), li (model conversion/quant config), kerry (runtime replay). Severity medium; creating ticket.

diego: I'll run a deterministic replay with --seed 42 and both fp16/int4 profiles and report back EOD. Command I'll use:

```bash
./replay_eval --model rdx-v2q --cohort investor-qa --seeds 42,99 --quant-profile asymmetric-default --compare rdx-v2 --out ./replay/1959001234
```

eval-bot: Created regression ticket RD-9987 and linked nightly alert 1959001234 -> RD-9987.

sam: If repro holds and it's quant-specific, we can gate the int4 promotion for long sequences (>512) as a stopgap — e.g., fallback to fp16 for requests with tokens>512.

kerry: I'll try replay with KV-cache disabled (`--kv-cache off`) and with tokenizer-lockdown to rule out runtime caching issues. Posting logs in this thread when done.

li: Also running a quick tokenizer-merge diff between conversion runs. If the merges shifted, that explains the extra tokens and downstream attention offsets.

maya: Good plan. I've added the SLO tag generation_quality and set a 48h follow-up. If this isn't resolved within that window we'll escalate to a short postmortem. Thanks all — please post status updates here. :calendar:

diego: :eyes: starting replay now, will update with repro status and logs.

kerry: Starting local replay; expecting logs in ~30m, will paste snippets if I see KV misses or assertion traces.

maya: FYI linking this to the nightly alert rotation so it shows up on tomorrow's oncall handoff.
